Definición Gini Recortado 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ineq)
library(DepthProc)
library(VGAM)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

prune_uni <- function(data, lower, upper) {
  if (lower == 0 && upper == 0) return(data)
  lower_bound <- if (lower > 0) quantile(data, lower) else min(data) / 2
  upper_bound <- if (upper > 0) quantile(data, upper) else 2 * max(data)
  data[data > lower_bound & data < upper_bound]
}

gini_pruned_uni <- function(data, lower, upper) {
  ineq(prune_uni(data, lower, upper), type = "Gini")
}

partir_pareto <- function(datos, porc_inf = 0.06, porc_sup = 0.10) {
  n <- length(datos)
  ordenados <- sort(datos)
  n_inf <- floor(porc_inf * n)
  n_sup <- floor(porc_sup * n)
  list(
    inf = ordenados[1:n_inf],
    central = ordenados[(n_inf + 1):(n - n_sup)],
    sup = ordenados[(n - n_sup + 1):n]
  )
}

transformar_central <- function(f) {
  function(datos) {
    partes <- partir_pareto(datos)
    c(partes$inf, f(partes$central), partes$sup)
  }
}

simular_pareto <- function(k_values, indices, transformar = identity,
                           n = 100, simulations = 1000) {
  filas <- lapply(k_values, function(k) {
    resultados <- t(vapply(seq_len(simulations), function(i) {
      datos <- transformar(rpareto(n, scale = 1, shape = k))
      vapply(indices, function(f) f(datos), numeric(1))
    }, numeric(length(indices))))
    data.frame(k = k, resultados)
  })
  do.call(rbind, filas)
}

simular_bootstrap <- function(k_values, indices, n = 100, simulations = 1000) {
  filas <- lapply(k_values, function(k) {
    partes <- partir_pareto(rpareto(n, scale = 1, shape = k))
    resultados <- t(vapply(seq_len(simulations), function(i) {
      central_bootstrap <- sample(partes$central,
                                  size = length(partes$central),
                                  replace = TRUE)
      datos <- c(partes$inf, central_bootstrap, partes$sup)
      vapply(indices, function(f) f(datos), numeric(1))
    }, numeric(length(indices))))
    data.frame(k = k, resultados)
  })
  do.call(rbind, filas)
}

resumir_por_k <- function(resultados) {
  resultados %>%
    group_by(k) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), mean))
}

a_formato_largo <- function(resumen) {
  pivot_longer(resumen, cols = -k, names_to = "Indices", values_to = "Value")
}

graficar_indices <- function(datos, colores, etiquetas, tipos_linea,
                             referencia = NULL, ylab = "Valor del índice",
                             linewidth = 1.2, linetype_guia = NULL,
                             legend_text_size = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot()

  if (!is.null(referencia)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_line(
        data = referencia,
        aes(x = k, y = Value, color = Indices, linetype = Indices),
        alpha = 0.3,
        linewidth = 1,
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    geom_line(
      data = datos,
      aes(x = k, y = Value, color = Indices, linetype = Indices),
      linewidth = linewidth
    ) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_color_manual(values = colores, labels = etiquetas) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = tipos_linea, labels = etiquetas) +
    labs(x = "k", y = ylab, color = "Índice", linetype = "Índice") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm")
    )

  if (!is.null(linetype_guia)) {
    p <- p + guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = linetype_guia)))
  }

  if (!is.null(legend_text_size)) {
    p <- p + theme(legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size))
  }

  p
}

indices_5 <- list(
  gini_006_09 = function(x) gini_pruned_uni(x, 0.06, 0.9),
  gini_0_0 = function(x) gini_pruned_uni(x, 0, 0),
  indice_robusto_0_0 = function(x) robust_index_pruned_uni(x, 0, 0),
  gini_0_08 = function(x) gini_pruned_uni(x, 0, 0.8),
  gini_01_0 = function(x) gini_pruned_uni(x, 0.1, 0)
)
indices_3 <- indices_5[c("gini_006_09", "gini_0_0", "indice_robusto_0_0")]

colores_5 <- c(
  gini_006_09 = "olivedrab",
  gini_0_0 = "mediumpurple4",
  indice_robusto_0_0 = "indianred",
  gini_0_08 = "steelblue",
  gini_01_0 = "tan3"
)
etiquetas_5 <- c(
  gini_006_09 = "Gini 0.06–0.9",
  gini_0_0 = "Gini 0–0",
  indice_robusto_0_0 = "EIRD",
  gini_0_08 = "Gini 0–0.8",
  gini_01_0 = "Gini 0.1–0"
)
tipos_5 <- c(
  gini_006_09 = "solid",
  gini_0_0 = "solid",
  indice_robusto_0_0 = "dashed",
  gini_0_08 = "solid",
  gini_01_0 = "dashed"
)

colores_3 <- colores_5[1:3]
etiquetas_3 <- etiquetas_5[1:3]
tipos_3_eird_punteado <- tipos_5[1:3]
tipos_3_solidos <- c(
  gini_006_09 = "solid",
  gini_0_0 = "solid",
  indice_robusto_0_0 = "solid"
)

k_values <- seq(10, 1, length.out = 50)
```

Prueba Gini Recortado

```{r}
datos <- 1:20
gini_pruned_uni(datos, 0.1, 0.8)
gini_pruned_uni(datos, 0, 0.8)
gini_pruned_uni(datos, 0.1, 0)
gini_pruned_uni(datos, 0, 0)
```

Definición EIRD1

```{r}
robust_index_pruned_uni <- function(data, lower, upper) {
  data_pruned <- prune_uni(data, lower, upper)
  datos_mat <- matrix(data_pruned, ncol = 1)

  prof <- depthProjection(datos_mat, datos_mat)
  prof_estan <- prof / (sum(prof) + 0.0001)
  prof_mat <- prof_estan %*% t(prof_estan)
  dist_mat <- as.matrix(dist(data_pruned))

  sum(dist_mat * prof_mat) / (2 * abs(median(data_pruned)))
}
```

Prueba IRD1

```{r}
datos <- 1:20
robust_index_pruned_uni(datos, 0.1, 0.8)
robust_index_pruned_uni(datos, 0, 0.8)
robust_index_pruned_uni(datos, 0.1, 0)
robust_index_pruned_uni(datos, 0, 0)
```

Escenario n° 1: distribución Pareto inalterada

```{r}
set.seed(123)

results <- simular_pareto(k_values, indices_5)
results_summary <- resumir_por_k(results)
results_long_original <- a_formato_largo(results_summary)
```

```{r}
graficar_indices(
  results_long_original,
  colores = colores_5,
  etiquetas = etiquetas_5,
  tipos_linea = tipos_5,
  ylab = "Índice",
  linewidth = 1
)
```

Escenario n° 2: datos centrales reemplazados por su mediana

```{r}
set.seed(123)

results_mediana <- simular_pareto(
  k_values, indices_3,
  transformar = transformar_central(function(x) rep(median(x), length(x)))
)
```

```{r}
results_summary_mediana <- resumir_por_k(results_mediana)
results_long_mediana <- a_formato_largo(results_summary_mediana)
```

```{r}
graficar_indices(
  results_long_mediana,
  colores = colores_3,
  etiquetas = etiquetas_3,
  tipos_linea = tipos_3_eird_punteado,
  referencia = results_long_original,
  linetype_guia = c("solid", "solid", "dashed")
)
```

Escenario n° 3: datos centrales uniformes

```{r}
set.seed(123)

results_unif <- simular_pareto(
  k_values, indices_3,
  transformar = transformar_central(function(x) runif(length(x), min = min(x), max = max(x)))
)
```

```{r}
results_summary_unif <- resumir_por_k(results_unif)
results_long_unif <- a_formato_largo(results_summary_unif)
```

```{r}
graficar_indices(
  results_long_unif,
  colores = colores_3,
  etiquetas = etiquetas_3,
  tipos_linea = tipos_3_solidos,
  referencia = results_long_original,
  linetype_guia = c("solid", "solid", "solid")
)
```

Escenario n° 4: datos centrales espejados

```{r}
set.seed(123)

results_esp <- simular_pareto(
  seq(10, 0.9, length.out = 50), indices_3,
  transformar = transformar_central(function(x) {
    punto_medio <- min(x) + (max(x) - min(x)) / 2
    2 * punto_medio - x
  })
)
```

```{r}
results_summary_esp <- resumir_por_k(results_esp)
results_long_esp <- a_formato_largo(results_summary_esp)
```

```{r}
graficar_indices(
  results_long_esp,
  colores = colores_3,
  etiquetas = etiquetas_3,
  tipos_linea = tipos_3_solidos,
  referencia = results_long_original,
  linetype_guia = c("solid", "solid", "solid"),
  legend_text_size = 11
)
```

Escenario n°5: Parte central bootstrapeada

```{r}
set.seed(123)

results_boot <- simular_bootstrap(k_values, indices_3)
```

```{r}
results_summary_boot <- resumir_por_k(results_boot)
results_long_boot <- a_formato_largo(results_summary_boot)
```

```{r}
graficar_indices(
  results_long_boot,
  colores = colores_3,
  etiquetas = etiquetas_3,
  tipos_linea = tipos_3_solidos,
  referencia = results_long_original,
  linetype_guia = c("solid", "solid", "solid"),
  legend_text_size = 11
)
```
